title: Working in a hotel
instructions: Daniel oteldeki işini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; saatleri, dilleri ve sevmediği şeyi karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I am Daniel, and I work in a hotel in Rome.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I am a receptionist. I start work at seven in the morning and finish at three.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I speak Italian, English and a little Spanish.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Every day, I help guests with their rooms, taxis and restaurants.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Many guests are from America and Japan.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I like my job because I meet people from different countries.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But I don't like working at the weekend. My friends are free, and I am at work!

script.speaker: s
script.text: Next year, I want to study tourism at university.
